reason: Authoritative spec for the pet window contract: physical-px units, ACL permissions for window APIs (setIgnoreCursorEvents, outerPosition, set_position), the click-through probe pattern (which this task REMOVES), and the pet:// event channel naming. Must be updated as part of this task to reflect the no-click-through decision and the new pet_get_work_area command.

New pet_get_work_area Rust command returns a struct serialized to JS; clampPetPosition helper is a pure TS function with a typed MonitorRect input. Follow the project's type-safety contract for both sides of the IPC boundary.

General code-quality bar (no dead code, no unneeded comments, error handling at boundaries). The probe simplification removes several try/catch blocks — make sure the remainder still obeys the boundary-only error-handling rule.

Task touches both Rust (commands.rs, lib.rs) and TS (PetApp.tsx, petPosition.ts). Cross-layer guide covers the IPC contract, shared type alignment, and where logic should live (work-area fetch in Rust, clamp math in TS as a pure function).
